kebab_example: aliyun winnexo mark-todos-read --tenant-id 10000 --todo-ids todo_abc123 --mark-all-read false --region cn-hangzhou
name: MarkTodosRead

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If you specify this parameter, the operation is performed as the user specified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proxy user, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the proxy user, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The list of to-do IDs. You can specify up to 100 IDs. This parameter is ignored when markAllRead is set to true
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The list of to-do IDs. You can specify up to 100 IDs. This parameter is ignored when markAllRead is set to true
parameters.name: todo_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to mark all to-do items as read. This parameter takes precedence over todoIds
parameters.help_zh: 全部标记已读（优先于 todoIds）
parameters.name: mark_all_read

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

unreadCount.description_en: The number of remaining unread to-do items after the operation

updatedCount.description_en: The number of to-do items marked as read in this request
